reason: Wrong side of the market: Beatitudes Campus is a 60-year-old nonprofit Life Plan/CCRC senior-living OPERATOR in Phoenix (~80 employees, ~$3.2M revenue, 200+ IL units) — i.e. the building owner that BUYS managed Wi-Fi, surveillance and access control from the low-voltage integrators and property-technology vendors David Shake actually sells to, not a vendor adding a technology line. All four matched jobs are core senior-living operations roles (Director of Assisted Living, Life Plan Residency Advisor, Maintenance Technician-HVAC, Security Officer) with zero technology-leadership signal; the match is a keyword collision where 'service plans' means resident CARE plans and 'Security Officer' means a human guard walking patrols, not video surveillance or recurring technology service contracts. The EDP is also structurally inapplicable — a CCRC billing monthly resident fees on Life Plan contracts is the opposite of a project-only contractor whose contracted recurring revenue covers zero months of payroll. No quotable line from any live posting redescribes the pain this CTO fixes.
